# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be respectful. This is a small, experimental project run by one maintainer.
Harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, and bad-faith behaviour aren't
welcome in issues, discussions, or any other project space.

## Standards

Examples of behaviour that keeps this a good place:

- Being kind, patient, and assuming good intent.
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focusing on what's best for the project and its users.

Examples of unacceptable behaviour: insults, harassment, publishing others'
private information, and any conduct that would be inappropriate in a
professional setting.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide, or delete comments and may block accounts for
behaviour that violates this policy. Report concerns privately to the maintainer
via GitHub (**@marmikshah**).

This is a condensed adaptation of the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), v2.1.
